research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: OneTrust is researching systems for detecting violations of data policies via dynamic classification of digital content, managing implementation of data controls for computing systems, and utilizing a large language model to modify digital data of an entity in response to system requirements frameworks. Together these efforts target automated data governance, privacy compliance, and AI driven control of data handling.

overview_description.description: OneTrust is the leading platform for responsible data and AI use. Headquartered in Atlanta with global offices, OneTrust helps organizations simplify consent and preference management, automate governance across privacy, security, IT, third-party, and AI risk, and enforce policies throughout the data lifecycle. The platform unites data and risk teams to drive trusted innovation. OneTrust holds more than 300 patents and serves over 14,000 customers worldwide, including Fortune 500 companies and small businesses, across industries such as financial services, healthcare, and technology.

about_short_description.short_description: OneTrust is the AI-Ready Governance platform helping organizations accelerate innovation while ensuring responsible data use.

product.name: OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform
product.description: A governance platform that connects privacy, risk, data, compliance, and AI workflows with continuous monitoring, automated controls, and policy enforcement.

product.name: AI Governance
product.description: Software for embedding governance, compliance, and controls across the AI lifecycle, including oversight of AI use, risk, and regulatory obligations.

product.name: Privacy Automation
product.description: Software for automating privacy management throughout the data lifecycle, including privacy assessments, compliance workflows, and incident management.

product.name: Consent & Preferences
product.description: Software for collecting, managing, and enforcing consumer consent and communication preferences across digital channels and business processes.

product.name: Data Use Governance
product.description: Software for governing data use with policy controls and real-time enforcement to support compliant analytics, AI, and other data-driven activities.

product.name: Tech Risk & Compliance
product.description: Software for managing technology risk and compliance processes, including assessments, controls, monitoring, remediation, and reporting.
